about: Values OpenMouse recorded from real Logitech hardware and user diagnostics, as stated in its sources (mouse-protocol commit e53af6d5, AGPL-3.0-or-later). They are third-party observations, not UDB evidence. Replies here are rebuilt around those values with UDB's software ID.

observations.source: src/drivers/logitech/hidpp.test.ts, hidppResponder: 'exactly as captured from a G HUB-merged G502 X PLUS receiver'
observations.what: An empty receiver slot answers HID++ 1.0 error 0x08 (unknown device); the receiver's own index 0xFF answers HID++ 1.0 error 0x01 (invalid command).

observations.source: src/drivers/logitech/hidpp.test.ts: 'the legacy report-rate bitmap decodes the G402's advertised rates'
src/drivers/logitech/hidpp.test.ts: 'Confirmed from a user diagnostic: transportIds {Wireless: "40BD", USB: "C0A8"}' (PRO X 2 Superstrike)
src/drivers/logitech/hidpp.test.ts: 'a Lightspeed Superlight 2 reads the wireless 0x8061 list, not the cable's 1 kHz list' (OpenMouse issue #224)
docs/logitech-testing.md and src/drivers/logitech/hidpp.ts setPollingRate: Superlight-era mice reject the live 0x8060/0x8061 write
